name: picolocus-monorepo
description: Modular client-side micro-intelligence SDK providing non-destructive UI navigation, hybrid search, and verbatim clause highlighting without chat or LLM hallucinations
author: Sai Jyothi Kumar <saikumarjyo14@gmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm test
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@picolocus/core && npm run build --workspace=@picolocus/cli && npm run build --workspace=@picolocus/web && npm run build --workspace=@picolocus/onnx
scripts.test:queries: node --import tsx packages/cli/src/bin.ts test-queries --config sandbox/demo-saas/picolocus.config.json --queries sandbox/demo-saas/golden-queries.json
scripts.smoke:model: node --import tsx packages/cli/src/bin.ts smoke --config sandbox/demo-saas/picolocus.config.json --models-dir sandbox/demo-saas/public/models
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/web packages/onnx && npx tsc -p sandbox/demo-saas/tsconfig.json --noEmit
